intro: They say someone is locked up deep in a dungeon, far from here.
Three locked gates stand in the way.
Something is waiting in that chest. Face it and press Ⓐ.
shield: Hold it up with Ⓑ. It pushes enemies back one step.
sword: Press Ⓐ to swing it at whatever is in front of you.
key: It opens one locked gate or door.
cellKey: Somebody must be locked up down here.
heart: A heart container! You can hold one more heart.
locked: Its key must be somewhere close by.
gateLocked: Its key is hidden somewhere on this side.
died: Every world is new. Ⓐ to go on.
secretHint: It gives a little. Try a hit.
